purpose: Controlled D1-D9 release-native drawing pipeline. Separates model semantics from drawing presentation, preserves claim identity/provenance, and prevents design-review fallback callouts from becoming release authority.

DESIGN_REVIEW_BASE.rule: V10 semantic base is retained for design review and visual work. Fallback Cxx callouts are traceable but cannot satisfy release-native PMI/D7 requirements.

RELEASE_NATIVE_D1_D9.rule: Released size/tolerance/GD&T/datum/surface semantics originate from controlled model PMI/native annotations or controlled property/spec references. Drawing is a projection, not a second semantic authority.

solidworks_2018_transport.proven_project_fact: SW2018 native Drawing View / Model View import options can transfer DimXpert annotations when annotation-view orientation matches. K01 has NOT proven InsertModelAnnotations3 as a DimXpert transport; prior Model Items path yielded DIMXPERT_COUNT=0.
solidworks_2018_transport.release_native_rule: D5 must use a capability-qualified transport recorded by exemplar evidence. Do not assume InsertModelAnnotations3 transfers DimXpert. Do not retry rejected PropertyManager UI automation as a primary mechanism.
solidworks_2018_transport.annotation_view_rule: PMI authoring is planned by normalized annotation_view_role. D2 evidence binds that role to an actual SOLIDWORKS annotation-view identity/orientation; D3 verifies it.
solidworks_2018_transport.seed_rule: For K01/SW2018, approved linked SLDDRW seed reuse/reference-safe relink is preferred when it preserves proven structure. New-document generation is optional, not mandatory.

characteristic_authoring_contract.reason: One characteristic may contain claims that belong to different annotation/drawing views (for example C05 flange OD vs flange thickness).
characteristic_authoring_contract.annotation_view_required_when: carrier is geometry/PMI/GD&T/datum and action authors/verifies model annotation; not required for TITLE_BLOCK/GENERAL_NOTE/property carriers
characteristic_authoring_contract.variation_rule: A controlled claim may use a fit, numeric tolerance, GD&T, basic/reference semantics, or an explicit controlled general-tolerance policy. A null/OPEN variation is never replaced by a template default.
characteristic_authoring_contract.identifier_rule: characteristic_tag / claim_id is inspection/trace identity. Assembly BOM balloons remain a separate numbering system.
characteristic_authoring_contract.authoring_order_rule: Datum/DRF first, then size/fit, location/pattern, GD&T, surface, material/process. D1 task order is controlled by authoring class, not Cxx lexical order.

binding_contract.authority: semantic/geometric signature + controlled feature context; runtime face IDs/indices are non-authoritative
binding_contract.minimum_evidence: D3 resolves each release-native claim uniquely to the intended geometry and records signature evidence
binding_contract.release_rule: Required L2/L3 level must pass for release-critical bindings; save-close-reopen alone is insufficient.

nodes.name: AUTHORING_PLAN
nodes.input: S4C engineering Product Definition drawing slice + S2 drawing-authoring context + parts registry + pipeline policy
nodes.acceptance: all claim targets classified; controlled authoring claims have target view role and a binding anchor/explicit blocker; no duplicate claim_id; route/delivery blockers explicit

nodes.output: native model PMI + D2 authoring evidence

nodes.name: AUTHORING_VERIFY_BINDING_INVARIANCE
nodes.acceptance: For first P007 exemplar: C01/C02/C09 identity/readback + annotation-view identity + semantic geometry binding + L1 save/reopen + L2 ForceRebuild + source SHA invariance. Release-native D3 additionally requires qualified L3 perturb/restore recipe.

nodes.name: DRAWING_NATIVE_DEFINITION_COMPILE
nodes.input: S4C compiled Product Definition + D3 evidence + parts registry
nodes.acceptance: reproducible fingerprint; every release-native claim has proven model carrier/provenance

nodes.input: D4 + approved template/seed + part registry + transport capability evidence
nodes.output: linked SLDDRW with views/sections/imported model semantics
nodes.acceptance: expected imported claim identities/counts match D4; no build errors; transport method recorded

nodes.name: HUMAN_LAYOUT_ONLY
nodes.acceptance: pre/post semantic fingerprint identical; leaders/placement/views only; semantic edit => STOP + EFR

nodes.name: SEMANTIC_QA
nodes.input: SLDDRW + D4 + parts registry + drawing policy
nodes.acceptance: For first exemplar scope: zero machine BLOCK findings for authorized C01/C02/C09 presentation, no unauthorized visible C05/other semantics, no dangling/manual/override dimensions, MMGS/ISO/FIRST_ANGLE/A3 profile. Release D7 remains HOLD on D3 L3, configuration/effectivity, D6 pre/post fingerprint and open Product Definition claims.

nodes.name: VISUAL_QA
nodes.input: temporary preview PDF/raster from post-D6 SLDDRW
nodes.acceptance: no clipping/critical overlap/unreadable text + engineer approval; no D8->D9 cycle

nodes.name: EXPORT_BASELINE
nodes.input: D7 PASS + D8 PASS + approved SLDDRW + delivery profile
nodes.acceptance: only required formats exported; capability/supplier acceptance gates satisfied; hashes recorded in baseline

d7_checks.rule: Every release-native controlled CLAIM required by D4 is present exactly once in the intended drawing/annotation-view mapping unless the controlled representation explicitly permits a composite single carrier.
No release-semantic drawing annotation exists without a registered characteristic/claim/provenance mapping.
No dangling release dimensions/annotations.
No duplicate/contradictory representation of the same claim/feature.
Every released dimension has explicit model variation semantics or a controlled general_tolerance_policy_ref. OPEN/default/template tolerance is prohibited.
Drawing datums/DRF match D4/model PMI datum semantics.
Drawing/model/Product Definition revision/effectivity are compatible and current.
Title block/material/part identity properties match controlled registries.
Characteristic tags/inspection IDs are unique and match D4; do not conflate them with BOM balloon item numbers.

No manual drawing tolerance/GD&T may satisfy release. Verify annotation provenance by characteristic/claim -> model PMI/native annotation -> drawing annotation identity; comparing only numeric tolerance values is insufficient.
Sheet/view scales are explicit and conform to drawing profile.
View bounding boxes do not critically overlap; annotation overlap remains D8/human-readable check.
If a controlled general_tolerance_policy_ref exists it is correctly referenced; otherwise no general tolerance note is required or invented.
If a controlled default surface-finish policy exists it is projected; otherwise no default roughness is invented.
D6 pre/post semantic fingerprint is unchanged; semantic change during layout requires EFR/change control and re-entry upstream.
Imported annotation-view identity/orientation matches D1/D3 target mapping for every release-native claim.
Drawing document length unit is MMGS/mm for K01-D-006 unless a controlled exception exists.
No release dimension uses a local display-unit override unless the exception is registered in Product Definition/drawing policy.
Each native displayed dimension, converted to canonical units, agrees with its D4/model claim value and variation semantics.
Drawing standard/projection/sheet profile matches the controlled ISO/first-angle/A3 profile or an approved exception.

release_preconditions: P007 manufacturing route selected/qualified for process-dependent characteristics
required claim-level feature signatures/binding anchors captured and D3 invariance qualified
supplier/manufacturer delivery-format acceptance recorded; STEP AP242 PMI is conditional, not presumed
all release-blocking Product Definition OPEN/PARTIAL items closed or formally dispositioned
prohibited: automatic leader routing/overlap resolution as release acceptance
manual retyping of released tolerance/GD&T in drawing
InsertModelAnnotations3 treated as proven DimXpert transport without K01 capability evidence
design-review PROJECTION_FALLBACK counted as release-native D7 coverage

d2_authorization_policy.rule: An OPEN manufacturing route blocks route/process-dependent claims and release, not unrelated controlled claims. D1 emits d2_authorizable_claim_ids; D2 may mutate only that set in a dedicated working copy.
d2_authorization_policy.fail_closed: UNCLASSIFIED is not authorizable for release-native D2.

exemplar_lane.purpose: Create one real manual P007/D006 exemplar before D5 automation; capture annotation-view/import/layout behavior.
exemplar_lane.allowed: D2 route-independent controlled claims + manual SW import/layout on dedicated copies
exemplar_lane.forbidden: counting V10 fallback notes or route-dependent/open claims as release-native coverage
exemplar_lane.exit: exemplar capture PASS + human visual QA; release remains HOLD until full D3/D4/D7/D8/D9.

family_planning.rule: D1 consumes family/view-routing context. Family rules decide representation/routing only; they never create Product Characteristics or tolerance values.
family_planning.redundant_view: AXIAL_EXTERNAL unless an external-only controlled claim later requires it

v15_first_exemplar_assurance.scope: K01-P-007 / K01-D-006 manual exemplar only; not a manufacturing-release waiver

d3.rule: L3 is not guessed. A real benign parameter, allowed delta and restore acceptance must be controlled before automatic perturbation.

v15_first_exemplar_assurance.same_drawing_rule: D7 defects are corrected on the existing V12 exemplar. Do not generate a new drawing and do not add engineering semantics manually.
